faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Free Quizlet Alternative
faq.description: Have more questions? Contact our support team via email or social media anytime.

items.title: Is TurboLearn really completely free? Are there any hidden costs?
items.description: Yes, TurboLearn is 100% free! No credit card required, no hidden fees, no paywalls. All features including unlimited flashcard sets, AI smart learning, offline access, and more are permanently free. We believe quality education should be accessible to everyone.

items.title: What advantages does TurboLearn have over Quizlet?
items.description: TurboLearn offers all Quizlet Plus features completely free. Our AI learning algorithms are more advanced, privacy protection is better, we support offline learning, and there are no ads. Additionally, our spaced repetition algorithm is based on the latest cognitive science research for higher learning efficiency.

items.title: Can I import my existing flashcards from Quizlet?
items.description: Absolutely! TurboLearn supports one-click import from Quizlet, Anki, StudyBlue, and other platforms. Simply export as CSV or text file, then import into TurboLearn. We also support batch import to save you time.

items.title: What study modes does TurboLearn support?
items.description: We offer multiple study modes: Flashcard mode (flip cards), Quiz mode (multiple choice), Matching game (pair matching), Spelling mode (dictation practice), and Study mode (comprehensive learning). AI automatically adjusts difficulty and review frequency based on your performance.

items.title: How do TurboLearn's AI features work?
items.description: Our AI system analyzes your learning behavior and memory curve to intelligently recommend content for review. AI can also automatically generate flashcards from documents, identify image content, and generate relevant example sentences. These features are all based on advanced machine learning algorithms to make learning more efficient.

items.title: Can I use TurboLearn offline?
items.description: Yes! Download our mobile app or use the browser's offline feature to study anytime, anywhere without internet connection. All learning progress automatically syncs to the cloud when you're back online.

items.title: How many languages does TurboLearn support?
items.description: TurboLearn supports learning content in 100+ languages, including Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, and more. We also provide text-to-speech functionality with multiple accents, especially suitable for language learning.

items.title: Can teachers use TurboLearn to manage classes?
items.description: Of course! We provide dedicated teacher account features to create classes, assign learning tasks, track student progress, and view learning statistics. Teachers can share flashcard sets with students, and students can collaborate on content creation. All these features are completely free.
